# Chickenloop — watersports job board & talent network

> Global watersports jobs and talent network for kite, foil, surf, sail, dive, and yacht crew. Site: [chickenloop.com](https://www.chickenloop.com)

## Primary pages

- [Jobs](https://www.chickenloop.com/jobs): browse open watersports roles
- [Companies](https://www.chickenloop.com/companies): watersports centres and schools
- [Talent](https://www.chickenloop.com/talent): instructor and crew profiles
- [Map](https://www.chickenloop.com/map): jobs and centres on a map
- [Career advice](https://www.chickenloop.com/career-advice): guides for watersports pros

## Live job market insights

These pages answer specific questions with real-time job counts from our database:
